EmailTemplate.subject: How much does it cost you to get paid?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello!
Our data shows travel businesses like yours lose 5.4% of revenue yearly to payments processing costs. Is {{company.Company Name:default=your company}} incurring similar costs?
Flywire <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/travel/dmc]]> works with hundreds of DMCs, Travel Operators, and Accommodation providers to save them money and streamline their international customer payments.
If {{company.Company Name:default=your company}} accepts a lot of international customer payments, Flywire may be able to save you over 1% on your processing fees.
If you’re interested in setting up some time to discuss your payment processes and see if Flywire is a fit for your business, please schedule some time here <[[https://meet.yesware.com/me/annesophie-kadjo/30min]]>.
Looking forward to talking to you!
Best,
Sydney
Sydney Banks Sales Manager, Travel
